title: Slime saplings, fungus and the ender propagule on PlutoLib behaviours
goal: Port SlimeSaplingBlock, SlimeFungusBlock, SlimePropaguleBlock and SlimePropaguleLeavesBlock from the original Java onto PlutoLib behaviours (random_tick, bonemeal, can_survive) in tconstruct/mixins/tconstruct/api/src/world.rs (function register_saplings). Growing a tree needs world generation, which PlutoLib does not have yet: keep the growth step as a call to a function `grow_tree(world, pos, kind)` that you leave as a documented stub returning false, and mark the classes partial. Delete only the injections whose whole behaviour you ported.
stop_and_report_if: a PlutoLib behaviour API call you need does not exist
removing an injection would remove the tree growth that nothing else replaces: keep that injection and say so
notes: The tree growth modules (source-sapling-tree, source-slime-tree-shape, source-ender-tree-*, island modules) stay: world generation is a later task. Same rules for helper files, modules and tools/injection_limits.json as in world-plants-grass.
